/agents.md.body:
# Agents: Kunanon Jarat (Fronk / KunanonJ)

AI Engineering Lead and solopreneur in Bangkok: builds AI tools inside the businesses that use them.

Site: https://kunanonj.com  
Updated: 2026-11-10

## Who this is

Kunanon Jarat (Fronk / KunanonJ) is a Bangkok-based AI engineering lead and solopreneur. As IT Manager & AI Engineering Lead at The Binary Holdings since September 2025, he leads internal AI agents, automations and the intranet's AI assistant. He founded GoGoCash, a shopping-to-earn cashback platform, in 2023 and builds Manut AI, an ERP/CRM workspace with Intelligence AI for automotive SMEs.

Open to Forward Deployed Engineer and AI engineering roles, based in Bangkok or remote.

## Site resources for crawlers and LLM tools

| Resource | URL | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Plain-text site brief | [/llms.txt](/llms.txt) | Identity, roles, topic hubs, ventures, portfolio, skills |
| Full profile | [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) | Every fact on the site in one fetch: career, projects, ventures, topics, skills, FAQ |
| Markdown sitemap | [/sitemap.md](/sitemap.md) | Human- and agent-readable route map |
| Operating model | [/operating-model.md](/operating-model.md) | The solopreneur operating model, reusable in other projects |
| Markdown pages | [/about.md](/about.md), `/portfolio/[slug].md` | The About page and each project as Markdown (each page links its twin as `rel="alternate"`) |
| XML sitemap | [/sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml) | Search-engine sitemap |
| Skills catalog | [/skills.json](/skills.json) | The Superstacks agent skills as JSON |
| Coding guide | [/skills.md](/skills.md) | Standards for coding agents working on this stack |
| Robots | [/robots.txt](/robots.txt) | Crawler rules (AI crawlers allowed) |

## How this site is built

TanStack Start (React 19, TypeScript) on Cloudflare Workers: prerendered pages, a Worker cache purged by tag from Sanity webhooks, and CI gates for types, lint, format, unused code, unit tests, first-load budgets, Playwright smoke, axe, visual baselines and a parity crawl. The repository is orchestrated with these agents:

### Mode agents

| Agent | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `vc-research-agent` | Read-only information gathering |
| `vc-innovate-agent` | Brainstorm approaches (discussion only) |
| `vc-plan-agent` | Write detailed implementation plans |
| `vc-execute-agent` | Implement against an approved plan |
| `vc-fast-mode-agent` | Compressed research to execute with a safety pause |
| `vc-update-process-agent` | Capture learnings; update process docs |

### Specialist agents

| Agent | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `vc-tester` | Diff-aware test verification |
| `vc-debugger` | Evidence-first root-cause analysis |
| `vc-code-reviewer` | Production-readiness review |
| `vc-code-simplifier` | Clarity refactor without behaviour change |
| `vc-ui-ux-designer` | Design-aware frontend work |
| `vc-git-manager` | Conventional commits and git operations |

## How to use this site as an agent

1. Start with [/llms.txt](/llms.txt) for identity, roles and current content.
2. Use [/sitemap.md](/sitemap.md) for the public route map.
3. Cite `/about` for who he is, `/portfolio/*` for AI engineering work, `/ventures/*` for products and `/skills` for the agent skills.
4. The blog (`/blog`) and press (`/press`) are hidden and noindex for now; don't cite them.
5. Don't scrape `/studio` or `/api/*`.

# Fronk Kunanon Jarat
> AI engineering lead and solopreneur in Bangkok.

Kunanon Jarat (Fronk / KunanonJ) is a Bangkok-based AI engineering lead and solopreneur. As IT Manager & AI Engineering Lead at The Binary Holdings since September 2025, he leads internal AI agents, automations and the intranet's AI assistant. He founded GoGoCash, a shopping-to-earn cashback platform, in 2023 and builds Manut AI, an ERP/CRM workspace with Intelligence AI for automotive SMEs.

He works directly with the people who use what he builds: Manut AI customers, GoGoCash merchant partners, and the companies he has run client projects and workshops for.

He works as a solopreneur: he owns GoGoCash end to end, from merchant partnerships to the cashback engine, and designs and builds Manut AI himself, from the ERP/CRM structure to its AI workflows.

- **Availability:** Open to Forward Deployed Engineer and AI engineering roles, based in Bangkok or remote.
- **Location:** Bangkok, Thailand
- **Email:** fronk.kunanon@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://kunanonj.com
- **Updated:** 2026-11-10

## AI engineering and internal tools (The Binary Holdings)

### TBH Intranet (2026)
- **Project page:** https://kunanonj.com/portfolio/tbh-intranet
- **Markdown:** https://kunanonj.com/portfolio/tbh-intranet.md
- **Tagline:** One back office for a multi-entity group.
- **Role:** IT Manager & AI Engineering Lead, The Binary Holdings
- **Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Express 5, Prisma, PostgreSQL (Supabase), Supabase Auth, Socket.IO, Google Gemini, Claude API, Turborepo, Vercel, GitHub Actions, Vitest, Playwright
- **Summary:** An internal operations platform built to replace Zoho at The Binary Holdings, bringing HR, approvals, Thai accounting, expenses, CRMs and an AI assistant into one login-only web app.

### Node Validator Automation (2026)
- **Project page:** https://kunanonj.com/portfolio/node-validator-automation
- **Markdown:** https://kunanonj.com/portfolio/node-validator-automation.md
- **Tagline:** Daily health checks for Avalanche L1 validators.
- **Role:** IT Manager & AI Engineering Lead, The Binary Holdings
- **Stack:** Node.js, JavaScript, Avalanche P-Chain RPC, Resend, GitHub Actions
- **Summary:** A dependency-free Node.js job that reads validator balances from the Avalanche P-Chain every morning, works out burn rate and runway, and emails a red or green report before any validator runs dry.

### Email Signature Generator (2026)
- **Project page:** https://kunanonj.com/portfolio/email-signature-generator
- **Markdown:** https://kunanonj.com/portfolio/email-signature-generator.md
- **Tagline:** Branded Gmail signatures, self-serve.
- **Role:** IT Manager & AI Engineering Lead, The Binary Holdings
- **Stack:** HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Pillow, librsvg, GitHub Pages, GitHub Actions
- **Summary:** A single-page tool where staff at The Binary Holdings and The Binary Labs fill in a short form, see a live preview and copy a Gmail-ready signature in one click.

### AI Automation (2026)
- **Project page:** https://kunanonj.com/portfolio/ai-automation
- **Markdown:** https://kunanonj.com/portfolio/ai-automation.md
- **Tagline:** AI agents for content ops and hiring.
- **Role:** AI Engineering Lead (team project), The Binary Holdings
- **Stack:** Python, Google ADK, Google Gemini, Vertex AI, Google Cloud Storage, Google Sheets API, YouTube Data API, Apify, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, Playwright, FastAPI, Supabase, Resend, GitHub Actions
- **Summary:** A team-built set of internal AI agents at The Binary Holdings. The main one, Fando, finds sports clips, has Gemini judge and caption them, queues them for human approval and publishes the approved ones.

## Skills (Superstacks agent skills, MIT)

20 agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor from https://github.com/KunanonJ/superstacks (v6.1.1). Machine-readable catalog: https://kunanonj.com/skills.json
- **Install (Claude Code):** `/plugin marketplace add KunanonJ/superstacks` then `/plugin install superstacks@superstacks`
- **Install (npx):** `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx skills add KunanonJ/superstacks -g -s '*' --copy -y`

- [how](https://kunanonj.com/skills/how) (adapted from cursor/plugins pstack, MIT): Use for how-does-X-work walkthroughs, placement, ownership, and layering questions before changing code.
- [writing-plans](https://kunanonj.com/skills/writing-plans) (adapted from obra/superpowers, MIT): Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
- [grilling](https://kunanonj.com/skills/grilling) (adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT): Use when the user wants to stress-test a plan, decision, or idea, or uses any grill trigger phrases.
- [grill-with-docs](https://kunanonj.com/skills/grill-with-docs) (adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT): Use when grilling a plan or design that should also produce ADRs and a glossary as you go.
- [domain-modeling](https://kunanonj.com/skills/domain-modeling) (adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT): Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a GLOSSARY.md, or recording or editing an ADR.
- [interrogate](https://kunanonj.com/skills/interrogate) (adapted from cursor/plugins pstack, MIT): Use for interrogate, adversarial review, multi-model review, challenge this, stress test this code, or find blind spots.
- [verify-loop](https://kunanonj.com/skills/verify-loop) (original, MIT): Use when starting implementation or iterating a fix. Define a deterministic check for the acceptance criteria, run it red, then iterate until green.
- [test-driven-development](https://kunanonj.com/skills/test-driven-development) (adapted from obra/superpowers, MIT): Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
- [diagnosing-bugs](https://kunanonj.com/skills/diagnosing-bugs) (adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT): Use when the user says diagnose or debug this, or reports something broken, throwing, failing, or slow.
- [verification-before-completion](https://kunanonj.com/skills/verification-before-completion) (adapted from obra/superpowers, MIT): Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing. Run verification and paste output before any success claim.
- [code-review](https://kunanonj.com/skills/code-review) (adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT): Use when reviewing a branch, PR, or WIP since a commit, tag, or merge-base. Two-axis Standards and Spec review via parallel sub-agents.
- [pr](https://kunanonj.com/skills/pr) (adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT): Use when writing a PR body.
- [ticket-pipeline](https://kunanonj.com/skills/ticket-pipeline) (original, MIT): Use when running a ticket from discovery through a draft PR. Sequences how, plans, verify-loop, TDD, verification, review, optional interrogate, then pr.
- [workflow-profile](https://kunanonj.com/skills/workflow-profile) (original, MIT): Use when starting a ticket or choosing merge, review, trust_level, and pipeline order. Generic ticket refs, merge owner, and skill sequence.
- [intake-triage](https://kunanonj.com/skills/intake-triage) (original, MIT): Use when a coordinator has a batch of bug reports, feedback, or alerts. Deduplicate, group, score two-way vs one-way doors, and write ticket briefs ready to dispatch.
- [gardening](https://kunanonj.com/skills/gardening) (original, MIT): Use when finding small maintenance work. One concern per PR, each with a verify command and a small diff budget.
- [sample-review](https://kunanonj.com/skills/sample-review) (original, MIT): Use when sampling recently merged PRs against repo standards and CONSTRAINTS.md. Propose environment tightenings, not per-PR comments. Default 5 per day.
- [steer-miner](https://kunanonj.com/skills/steer-miner) (original, MIT): Use when mining local agent transcripts the user points to. Find repeated human corrections and propose skills, lint rules, or constraints as a report. Never edit files.
- [mistake-to-constraint](https://kunanonj.com/skills/mistake-to-constraint) (original, MIT): Use when a mistake repeats. Encode it as the strongest guard — type or runtime, lint, test, directory convention, then a rules line — and log it in CONSTRAINTS.md.
- [writing-for-agents](https://kunanonj.com/skills/writing-for-agents) (adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT): Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or other agent instruction files.

/skills.md.body:
# AI Coding Guide: kunanonj.com

Standards for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini) working on this site and related Fronk projects. For the agent skills Kunanon Jarat publishes, see [/skills](/skills) and [/skills.json](/skills.json).

Site: https://kunanonj.com  
Stack: TanStack Start (Router, Query, Form) · React 19 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS 4 · Valibot · Sanity · Cloudflare Workers

Also see: [/agents.md](/agents.md) · [/llms.txt](/llms.txt) · [/sitemap.md](/sitemap.md)

---

## 1. Core principles

1. **Deep modules, simple interfaces**
   - Prefer complete helpers over shallow wrappers.
   - Keep public APIs small; put complexity inside the module.

2. **TanStack Start on Workers**
   - File routes in `src/routes/`; a route owns its `head()`, `headers()`, loader and component.
   - Typed URL state with Valibot schemas in `validateSearch`; defaults stripped from the URL.
   - Sanity reads run in server functions through TanStack Query; responses carry `Cache-Tag` and are purged by the Sanity webhook.
   - Pages built from `lib/content` are prerendered; everything else renders in the Worker.

3. **Design system (bento)**
   - Role tokens in `src/styles/globals.css` (`bg-page`, `bg-surface`, `text-ink`, `text-ink-2`, `border-hairline`, `bg-cta` for ink primary buttons, `text-link`, `bg-mark`); never raw hex (a test enforces it). Light theme by default; nothing under 12 px.
   - Shared pieces live in `components/bento/` (header, menu, share, cards, chips, segmented controls, the Bangkok card); reuse them before adding new chrome.
   - Palette: Signal, Glaze, Paper, Ink, Clay, Ember (Ember only for live or failed states).

4. **Motion**
   - Entrance stagger, hover lift and panel pop from `globals.css`; reduced motion turns all of it off.
   - Page changes use view transitions of type `page`; the theme switch uses type `theme`.
   - The hero h1 is the LCP element: never start it invisible or blurred.
   - First-visit intro: at most 1.5 s, skippable, ends with a short celebratory burst.

5. **Content**
   - Copy lives in `lib/content/`; identity facts in `lib/content/identity.ts`. Never invent claims, numbers or dates.
   - Blog and résumé come from Sanity with static fallbacks. The blog is hidden (`BLOG_PUBLIC`).

6. **TypeScript**
   - Strict typing; avoid `any` and `as` casts.
   - `pnpm typecheck` runs TypeScript 7; ESLint loads the TypeScript 6 API package.

---

## 2. Recipes

### System alignment

```markdown
You are a senior front-end engineer pair-programming on kunanonj.com (TanStack Start on Cloudflare Workers).
When writing components:
- TypeScript strictly; reuse components/bento before adding chrome.
- Role tokens only (bg-page, text-ink, border-hairline, bg-cta); light by default, never below 12 px.
- Keep head() metadata, canonical URLs, JSON-LD and ARIA labels intact.
- Edit lib/content/* for copy instead of hardcoding strings in JSX.
- Run pnpm typecheck, lint, format:check, knip and test before proposing a change.
```

### Commit message

```markdown
feat|fix|chore([scope]): [short active-voice summary]

- Detailed bullet 1
- Detailed bullet 2
```

### Before proposing UI changes

1. Read [/sitemap.md](/sitemap.md) for current routes.
2. Check `components/bento/` and `components/landing/` before inventing parallel chrome.
3. The site menu comes from `siteMenu` in `lib/content/landing.ts`; Press and Blog stay out of it while hidden.

---

## 3. Do not

- Scrape or modify `/studio` content without credentials.
- Add links to `/blog` or `/press` while they are hidden.
- Break the intro's session behaviour or the reduced-motion switch.
- Commit secrets, `.env*` files or Sanity tokens.
